runs.t: On leading a team's transition to AI-native product development.
I built the mentor-matching software myself and ran it for a live Cisco program across three years — we tackled real AI judgment calls beyond the initial enthusiasm.
On being the durable owner of a product area — UX, vision, KPIs, quality bar.
Founding executive team, Head of Design, and a year as interim Head of Product for a platform later acquired by RSA Archer — evidence I've owned an outcome rather than a queue.
On evolving an operating model, a hiring bar, and craft standards.
I rebuilt Carbonite's product design function after a major workforce reduction — the principles, engagement model and hiring bar written down rather than assumed.
On Registry as the heart of Babylist.
I co-founded a marketplace connecting performers, venues, presenters and audiences and shipped four MVPs in year one — the same multi-sided shape as Registry.
